objective: Protect the validated 10-Core / one-shared-250-USDC primary engine and find five robust Binance Spot USDC Satellite gap-fillers, starting from SUIUSDC, NEARUSDC, UNIUSDC, AAVEUSDC and BCHUSDC but replacing boundedly rejected seed markets when better USDC candidates exist. Satellites must monetize genuinely free Core capacity without reducing Core performance.
priorities: Preserve the validated ten-Core product unchanged while Satellite research proceeds.
Use original V1_STRATEGY / DMS_V1 as the neutral Satellite starting basis; never copy Core V6 profiles as Satellite seeds.

Treat SUI/NEAR/UNI/AAVE/BCH as seed candidates, not immutable final choices; after bounded causal rejection, discover replacement Binance Spot USDC markets using point-in-time tradability, liquidity and history eligibility only.
Select strategy/parameter/horizon candidates on training only. Direct-USDC holdout, shifted, future and red-team evidence may reject but never select or retune.

Satellites may use only genuinely free shared-account capacity. They must never block protected Core allocation; a materially superior Core opportunity must be able to reclaim filler capital at the next executable opportunity.
Optimize after-cost incremental shared-account profit, genuine trade count, short capital occupancy and profit per occupied hour; idle coverage without profit is failure.
Final success is five robust USDC gap-fillers if evidence supports five; never force weak markets merely to hit a count.
research_fronts: clean unchanged V1 baseline on SUI/NEAR/UNI/AAVE/BCH
bounded per-market V1 evolution without Core-V6 template inheritance
short-horizon exits and handoff only after the five Satellite entry/exit strategies themselves are suitable
success_rule: Mission success requires five independently developed Satellite-V1 profiles (or fewer if evidence rejects a market) that, together in one shared 250-USDC account, materially monetize protected Core idle time and improve or preserve after-cost baseline/stress shared equity with zero unacceptable Core opportunity displacement. The ~90% idle interval is the opportunity pool, not a quota that may override profitability or safety.

profit_concession.note: For the final satellite/router architecture, higher activity is not allowed to buy lower robust shared-account profit. Research diagnostics may explore trade-offs, but promotion requires non-regressive baseline and stress performance.

recent_evidence.detail: 2/4/6h exact-full-Core-idle horizon family; UNI training winner 6h but direct-USDC rejected; SUI/NEAR/AAVE/BCH had no fully robust training horizon.
recent_evidence.next: Training-selected V1/DMS_V1 short-horizon free-capacity screen across all ten replacement candidates; Direct-USDC reject-only.
